240-574-1879-5470.description:

Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-1879-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.

Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

1562-6250-6757.description:
Cast Daretti by paying {4}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Daretti enters the battlefield, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token.
Resolve the Daretti trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Munitions to return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Put Machine God's Effigy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Machine God's Effigy, the Munitions token that was sacrificed and Weapons Manufacturing each trigger.
Resolve the Munitions trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token..
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Munitions to return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.

553-6555-7467.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar.
In response, cast Sudden Setback by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

903-2199-7841.notablePrerequisites: Karplusan Minotaur has indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
903-2199-7841.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to Darksteel Angel, and Karplusan Minotaur cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2646-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.

Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1497-2173-5220-7452.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

710-2292-7424.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4559-4802-5330-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.

Resolve the Atog ability.

Repeat.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.

Repeat.

Resolve the Megatog ability.

When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.

You control at least one additional creature that has a different power than Selvala's.

When the Izoni token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Insect creature tokens equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

Repeat each turn.

2-1651-1770-4306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four devotion to any color.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the largest amount of devotion to a color you have minus four.
2-1651-1770-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.

Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Rollicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Rollicker for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Mogis's Warhound.
Repeat.

Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Junk Diver from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.

Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Junk Diver.
Junk Diver dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Myr Retriever from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 7, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

Marang River Prowler enters the battlefield as a copy of Atsushi due to Infinite Reflection.
Choose to put Marang River Prowler into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Marang River Prowler dies, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.

Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.

Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it

507-3176.description:
Any time a player would cast a spell from their hand it gets exiled from possibility storm.
Archon of Emeria prevents them from casting the other card from possiblity storm resulting in a lock.

3617-4305-4477.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Greenwarden of Murasa.
3617-4305-4477.description:

Move to your next turn.

Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk to your hand.
